list.emptyDescription: Create a model repository, then upload model files to get started.

upload.title: Upload Model Files
upload.description: Run this command to upload local files to this model.

download.title: Download Model
download.description: Run this command to download this model.

useModel.title: Use This Model with {{engine}}

intro.transformers: The following steps load and run the model with Transformers on your GPU server.
intro.vllm: The following steps start vLLM on your GPU server and fetch the model from MatrixHub.
intro.sglang: The following steps start SGLang on your GPU server and fetch the model from MatrixHub.

steps.prepareHint: Run the following commands on the GPU server that will serve the model
steps.configureHint: A token is required for private projects or when authentication is enabled
steps.generate: Generate code for the model type
steps.generateTooltip: The task type and messages structure are switched automatically from the model's task labels. You can also pick one manually.
steps.generateHint: Code is generated from the model's capabilities. Replace the image URL and prompt, then run it.
steps.testRequestHint: The request body follows the model type. Replace the image URL and prompt, then run it.

useModel.lowLevelNote: The low-level API uses Transformers step by step: load the processor, build the chat template, preprocess inputs, call generate, and slice the output. AutoModel* is a generic example; some architectures (e.g. Qwen, LLaVA) require their own model class.

delete.title: Delete Model
delete.warning: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete the {{name}} model repository and all of its files, including weights.

set.label: Mark as featured model
set.confirmation: Are you sure you want to mark model {{name}} as a featured model?
set.error: Failed to mark model as featured

unset.label: Remove from featured models
unset.confirmation: Are you sure you want to remove {{name}} from featured models?
unset.success: Model removed from featured models successfully
unset.error: Failed to remove model from featured models

create.modelNameHelper: Supports letters, numbers, underscore, hyphen, and dot. Must start with a letter or number.
create.uploadTip: After creating the model, you can upload files using the command line.
create.emptyProjectDescription: Create a project first. It will be selected automatically.
